title: Complaints
body:
## Our commitment

[Placeholder] Dr Tranter Aesthetics takes patient feedback and complaints seriously and is committed to resolving concerns promptly, fairly and respectfully, in line with our broader philosophy of transparent, considered care.

## How to raise a concern

[Placeholder] Patients wishing to raise a complaint are encouraged to contact the clinic directly in the first instance, either by phone, email, or in person, so the matter can be addressed as quickly as possible.

[Placeholder] Where appropriate, complaints will be acknowledged within [xx business days] and a resolution or response provided within [xx business days] of the matter being raised.

## What happens next

[Placeholder] Complaints are reviewed by clinic management and, where relevant, the treating practitioner. You will be kept informed of the progress of your complaint and any outcome or action taken as a result.

## External escalation

[Placeholder] Where a concern cannot be resolved directly with the clinic, patients may escalate the matter to the relevant external health complaints body in their state or territory, or to AHPRA where the complaint relates to a registered practitioner’s conduct.
